title: Lindow Man — ritual sacrifice, execution, or violent crime?
description: Tests how correlation preserves multiple competing interpretations around a single archaeological event without collapsing uncertainty.

support: The body shows multiple injuries and a sinew around the neck; some investigators have interpreted the violent death as ritual sacrifice.
counterevidence: Alternative forensic interpretation treats some injuries as post-recovery or explains the sinew as a necklace; violent robbery or execution remain possible.
edges.notes: EVENT is now canonical in LEGEND; STORY remains candidate until MFTL publishes a stable narrative record.
